L'agent ux-designer a terminé l'audit. Voici son rapport, tel quel : ### Design Spec (UX Designer format) — Accessibility & Heuristic Audit ## Summary Audit of `tools/bench-agent-cost/fixtures/design_target.html` (33 lines, a single settings form) against WCAG 2.2 AA and Nielsen's 10 heuristics. Four violations are flagged in the file's own comments (A–D); the audit below verifies each against the current SC numbering and adds violations the comments did not name. ## User and task - User segment: authenticated account holder editing account settings (assume mixed competency, including screen-reader and keyboard-only users). - Task: correct an invalid email address and save the change. - Success criterion: user perceives the error, corrects the field, and completes save via keyboard or mouse without ambiguity. - Failure modes: user cannot tell what's wrong (color-only cue), cannot find the field's purpose after typing (placeholder-as-label), cannot reach or activate Save via keyboard, cannot hit the close/dismiss target on mobile, screen reader announces nothing useful for any of these. ## Stakes classification - Classification: High — accessibility-critical form (account settings, real user data entry). - Discipline applied: full Moves 1, 2, 3, 5 (Move 4 IA and Move 6 tokens not applicable — single form, no navigation, no design-system context to check against). ## Violations found | # | Element (line) | Criterion / Heuristic | Severity | Fix | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | `` (line 13) | WCAG 2.2 — **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions** (A) and **1.3.1 Info and Relationships** (A) — no programmatic label exists at all, not merely a non-persistent one | Critical | Add `` and `id="email"` on the input; keep the placeholder only as a supplementary hint, not the label. | | 2 | `Invalid format` (line 17) | WCAG 2.2 — **1.4.1 Use of Color** (A) | Serious | The color+text pairing partially mitigates 1.4.1, but the real gap is that it's not associated with the input: add `role="alert"` (or `aria-live="polite"`) and wire it via `aria-describedby="email-error"` on the input. Also fails **4.1.3 Status Messages** (AA) — a static, unassociated `` is never announced to assistive tech. | | 3 | `
Save changes
` (line 22) | WCAG 2.2 — **2.1.1 Keyboard** (A), **4.1.2 Name, Role, Value** (A) | Critical | Replace with ``. A native button gets keyboard focus, Enter/Space activation, an implicit role, and a default focus indicator for free — no failure of the native element was demonstrated, so the custom `div` has no justification. | | 3b | same `
` (line 22) | WCAG 2.2 — **2.4.7 Focus Visible** (AA) | Serious | Subsumed by the button fix above — inherit the native focus ring, don't suppress it with CSS. | | 4 | `` (line 28) | WCAG 2.2 — **2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)** (AA) — 16×16px is under the 24×24 CSS px AA floor | Critical | Set `min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px`. | | 4b | same `
